relations.text: Amazonに最大7,945,399株の10年ワラントを発行。大半はAmazonらの購入が一定額に達した場合に権利確定(年次報告)
relations.text_en: Issued Amazon a 10-year warrant for up to 7,945,399 shares; most vests only as Amazon and affiliates reach purchase thresholds (annual report)

source.label: AAOI 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The remaining 6,621,166 Warrant Shares may vest over the next 10 years, dependent on aggregate purchases by or on behalf of Amazon and its affiliates of $ 4 billion of the Company's products over this time period.
source.note: ワラントはAmazonの完全子会社が保有します。
source.note_en: The warrant is held by a wholly-owned subsidiary of Amazon.

relations.text: AAOIが3年・3,500万ドルの回転与信枠(増額で最大7,500万ドル)をBOK Financialを幹事として設定(2025年7月、8-K)
relations.text_en: AAOI entered a three-year $35M revolving credit facility (accordion to $75M) with BOKF, NA dba BOK Financial as agent (July 2025, 8-K)

source.label: AAOI Form 8-K(2025年8月6日)
source.quote: with BOKF, NA dba BOK Financial, as agent for secured parties. The Credit Facility provides the Company with a three-year, $35 million revolving line of credit.
source.note: 貸し手はBOK Financialの銀行子会社です。
source.note_en: The lender is the bank subsidiary of BOK Financial Corp.
